title: Chapter 194 - 194 The Security Guards Are Really Too Professional; Only Me!

Chapter 194 - 194 The Security Guards Are Really Too Professional; Only Me!

Chapter 194 - 194 The Security Guards Are Really Too Professional; Only Me!

194 The Security Guards Are Really Too Professional; Only Me!

Lin Xiaoyao struggled in the sea of clothes and bags.

Then, she picked up a few bags and came in front of Lin Fan. She said excitedly, “Brother, do you think I look better carrying this bag or this one?

“Mhm, this one seems more elegant!

“This is not bad either…

“Wow, this bag is so cute!”

Lin Fan looked at her fiddling with the bags and thinking seriously. He could not help but laugh, “Didn’t you say that it’s hard to carry a bag around?”

In fact, Lin Xiaoyao did not find it difficult to carry a bag around.

Even though she knew that Lin Fan was amazing and he said that she could spend his money freely, Lin Xiaoyao had never been someone who liked to spend money extravagantly.

Now, it was completely different!

That was because her brother already had a lot of clothes and bags. It would not be a problem for her to take a few!

Of course, Lin Xiaoyao would not admit to this…

She blinked her big eyes and said, “Really? Maybe it’s because I suddenly gained a lot of strength.”

Lin Fan looked at the way she was spouting nonsense and could not help but smile as he pinched her cheeks, “Eat more. You’re all skin and bones.”

Initially, Lin Xiaoyao was overjoyed.

Upon hearing this, her entire little face turned into a ball of anger. She pouted and shouted, “Brother!”

Seeing this…

Lin Fan smiled even more happily. Then, he handed the KP bag he had just taken out to Du Yujia and said, “Your bag.”

“Thank you.” Du Yujia quickly took the bag. Then, she took out her phone and said, “I’ll transfer the money to you.”

Lin Fan could not help but think highly of Du Yujia.

“It’s alright. You’re Lil Yao’s friend. It’s rare for you to come to Jiangbei. Take this bag as a gift.”

Then, he said to Tang Jiao beside him, “You should go and pick a bag too.”

Du Yujia and Tang Jiao hesitated.

Even though Lin Fan had a lot of bags, more than ten years of education had taught them not to take other people’s things casually… Especially if it was such an expensive Gucci bag.

Lin Xiaoyao said, “Don’t stand on ceremony. My brother has a lot of them anyway. It’s a waste to let them sit here!”

When the two of them heard this, they did not stand on ceremony anymore.

“By the way, Brother, why did you buy so many Gucci clothes and bags?” Lin Xiaoyao asked.

Tang Jiao and Du Yujia pricked up their ears.

Obviously, they were also very curious.

“Oh, I didn’t buy these bags. They were gifts from the president of Gucci. I’m a shareholder of the company,” Lin Fan said.

Silence.

The entire place suddenly fell silent.

Gucci’s shareholder?

Did that not mean that Lin Fan was one of the bosses of Gucci?

Heavens!

They did not know how much Gucci was worth.

However, this was still enough to shock them.

That was because… that was an internationally renowned company!

Lin Fan looked at the three of them and rubbed his nose. “What do you want to do next?”

Lin Xiaoyao was the first to react. “Flower Stem… Right, we’re going to buy Flower Stem’s essence.

“Flower Stem’s essence is very useful. After applying it a few times, your skin will become fair and bright. Acne marks and blackheads will disappear completely!”

Lin Xiaoyao’s tone became even higher.

Obviously, she really desired Flower Stem’s essence.

When Lin Fan heard this, his face turned weird.

Ever since Lin Fan handed the Beauty Water to Chu Yunyue, he never bothered himself with the matters of Flower Stem again.

Not long ago, Chu Yunyue had called him to tell him that Flower Stem’s essence was receiving a good response in the country.

However, Lin Fan did not think too much about it.

Now, even his sister knew about it?

Lin Xiaoyao thought that Lin Fan did not know about Flower Stem.

“Brother, you don’t know how popular Flower Stem is in Qing City! Their products are all snatched up as soon as they’re put on the shelves!”

Then, Lin Xiaoyao sighed and said, “I came to Jiangbei this time to try my luck. I just don’t know if I can buy it.”

Others could not buy it?

In fact, if Lin Fan wanted to, he could just buy the Beauty Water from the system with a thought!

One had to know…

Flower Stem’s essence was made by blending the Beauty Water with hundreds of times the amount of distilled water!

In the future, he would give his younger sister a better essence.

Now, he should satisfy her wish to get Flower Stem’s essence.

Thinking of this, Lin Fan said, “Let’s go. I’ll bring you to buy Flower Stem’s essence.”

“Alright!” Lin Xiaoyao said happily.

Then, Lin Xiaoyao carried a few bags into the Mercedes-Benz.

When they passed by the entrance of the Coiling Dragon Villa Complex, two rows of security guards had already lined up. Like soldiers, they greeted Lin Fan.

“The security guards are really dedicated to their work.” Tang Jiao could not help but sigh.

Lin Xiaoyao said, “I don’t know how many people live here. If they have to line up and salute like this to every owner who goes out, that’ll be too tiring.”

“That won’t happen,” Lin Fan said.

“Why?” Lin Xiaoyao asked.

“Because all the villas here are mine. They only need to salute me. How can they be tired?” Lin Fan said.

Silence!

The entire Mercedes-Benz G-Class suddenly fell silent!

All the villas were his… He had said this very calmly.

However, this sentence reverberated in the ears of Lin Xiaoyao, Du Jiayu, and Tang Jiao, causing their eardrums to hurt.

Gulp!

Du Jiayu felt her throat go dry. She could not help but swallow her saliva. She said, “Then…the sports cars and helicopter in the villa…”

“They’re all mine,” Lin Fan said.

“Ah! Brother, Brother! Go back! Let’s return quickly!” Lin Xiaoyao shouted excitedly.

“What’s wrong?” Lin Fan asked.

“I want to take a good look at our home!” Lin Xiaoyao shouted.

Lin Fan looked at her excited expression and did not dampen her spirits.

He turned the car around and returned to the Coiling Dragon Villa Complex.

The security guards standing at the door saw Lin Fan return and stood up straight again, greeting him.

Under the watchful eyes of the security guards, Lin Fan led Lin Xiaoyao, Du Jiayu, and Tang Jiao to open the doors of one villa after another.

They looked at each villa and saw that the decoration style was very different. Their eyes were dazzled.

When they arrived at Lin Fan’s villa, Lin Xiaoyao did not go in. Instead, she rushed to the helicopter and shouted, “Brother, do you have the key? I want to go in and take a look!”

“It’s not locked.” Lin Fan pulled open the door of the helicopter.

Whoosh!

Instantly, the luxurious interior of the helicopter appeared in front of everyone.

Lin Xiaoyao could not wait to get into the helicopter. She kept jumping around in the helicopter. She was as happy as a child.
